cohort: Infants aged 0-42 days presenting for sepsis evaluations, including those with and without neonatal herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection.
finding: Infants without neonatal HSV infection presenting for sepsis evaluations are significantly less likely to exhibit high-risk criteria such as seizures, skin lesions, elevated ALT, thrombocytopenia, CSF pleocytosis, or critical illness compared to infants with HSV.
gest_age: Term gestation (for the majority of cases identified)
